title: Company-wide policies and processes — Access, Change, Data, Procurement, Vendors, Travel, Templates
author: Aisha Chen
content:
Overview

Purpose: This document consolidates Redwood Inference's company-wide policies and standard operating procedures for access & permissions, change management, data management, procurement & expenses, vendor management, travel, and commonly used internal templates. It is intended for all employees, managers, and contractors and defines governance, owners, workflows, and required artifacts.

Scope: Applies to all Redwood employees, contractors, and third-party service providers. Exceptions must be approved by the relevant owner listed in the Governance table.

Governance & ownership

- Document owner: People Ops (owner: Aisha Chen).
- Policy stewards: Security (access & data controls), EngSRE (change management), Finance (procurement & expenses), Legal (vendor contracts).
- Review cadence: Annual review and after any major incident or regulatory change.

1) Access & Permissions

Principles:
- Least privilege by default.
- Role-based access for production services; attribute-based access for analytics and BI tooling.
- All elevated access requires approval and a documented justification.

Roles & examples:
- Employee (default): corporate apps, single-sign-on (SSO) account.
- Engineer: dev/test infra, staging clusters.
- Oncall SRE: production monitoring, incident tooling.
- Admin/Privileged: can access production secrets (requires separate approval).

Provisioning process (standard request):
1. Submit Access Request via Access Request template (link: /confluence/templates/access-request).
2. Manager approval (manager must confirm business justification).
3. Owner/team approver verifies scope and assigns role.
4. Security performs automated checks (MFA enabled, device compliance).
5. Access granted; request recorded in access audit log (retained 3 years).

Deprovisioning checklist (on termination or role change):
- Revoke SSO account within 24 hours of termination.
- Remove cloud IAM roles and group memberships within 24 hours.
- Deactivate VPN/SSH keys and rotate any shared credentials.
- Confirm removal in HR offboarding checklist.

Breakglass / emergency access:
- Breakglass requires an endorsed emergency request filed in the incident system and approval by two approvers (oncall lead + Security).
- All breakglass sessions are recorded and must include post-facto justification.

Access SLOs and audits:
- Provisioning SLA: 48 business hours for standard requests, 4 hours for urgent requests.
- Quarterly access review for production groups.
- Annual third-party access audit for vendor accounts.

2) Change Management

Change types:
- Standard (pre-approved, low-risk): routine infra config changes, non-prod deployments.
- Normal (scheduled): feature deployments, infra updates requiring approvals.
- Emergency: fixes to restore service; post-change review required.

Approval matrix (high-level):
- Dev/test changes: team lead approval.
- Production service changes: service owner + EngSRE review.
- Schema changes impacting multiple services: product + data owner sign-off.
- Security-sensitive changes: Security review required.

Change process (normal):
1. Create Change Request (template: /confluence/templates/change-request). Include impact analysis, rollback plan, test plan, and owners.
2. Submit to Change Advisory Board (CAB) if change class is medium or higher.
3. CAB reviews weekly; high-risk changes require an emergency call.
4. Schedule change within deployment windows (see Deployment windows table).
5. Execute, monitor, and complete post-change verification checklist.
6. Close change with verification artifacts and metrics.

Emergency changes:
- Use the Emergency Change flow: tag change as EMERGENCY, notify oncall and CAB, implement mitigation, and file a post-implementation report within 24 hours.
- Post-implementation review: within 3 business days.

Deployment windows:
| Environment | Allowed hours | Notes |
| Production | Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 PT (exceptions require CAB) | Emergency fixes allowed outside window |
| Non-prod | 24x7 | Standard change process applies |

Change SLAs:
- Normal change review: 5 business days.
- CAB decision on high-risk change: within 48 hours of submission.

3) Data Management

Data classification:
- Public: Suitable for public disclosure.
- Internal: Company-internal, non-sensitive.
- Confidential: Business-sensitive but not regulated.
- Restricted / PII / PHI: Regulated or high-risk personal data.

Handling rules by classification:
- Confidential & Restricted: Encryption at rest & transit (AES-256 / TLS 1.2+), strict RBAC, logging, and retention limits.
- Internal: Access need-to-know, logged.
- Public: Review for release approval.

Data retention & backups:
- Production DB backups: daily snapshots retained for 30 days; critical datasets have 90-day retention as defined by data owner.
- Audit logs: retained 3 years.
- Retention exceptions: require Legal + Data Owner sign-off.

Production data usage in non-prod:
- Production data copies require data masking or synthetic data unless explicitly approved by Data Owner and Security.
- Access to production exports requires an Access Request and documented use case; exports are time-bound and limited.

Data access request process:
1. Submit Data Access Request (template: /confluence/templates/data-access-request).
2. Data owner reviews and approves with conditions (masking, scope, duration).
3. Security performs DLP scan before dataset handoff.

Data breach & incident response:
- Follow Incident Response Security runbook (link: /confluence/security-and-compliance/incident-response-security).
- Notification thresholds: any confirmed PII or Restricted exposure triggers Legal and Customer Success notifications within 24 hours.

4) Procurement & Expenses

Procurement principles:
- Centralized tracking through Finance procurement system.
- Use preferred vendors from Vendor Catalog for discounts and pre-negotiated terms.
- Purchases > $50k require Legal and Finance director approval.

Approval flow (high-level):
- < $2k: manager approval.
- $2k–$50k: manager + Finance approval.
- > $50k: manager + Finance + Legal + executive sponsor.

Preferred vendors & tooling:
- Cloud infrastructure (preferred list): AWS, GCP, Azure (contact procurement for negotiated SKUs).
- Security tooling: Palo Alto, CrowdStrike (see vendor catalog).

Procurement request template (table):
| Field | Description | Example |
| Requestor | Employee name | Aisha Chen |
| Business justification | Why we need it | New GPU capacity for Dedicated pilot |
| Cost center | Finance code | ENG-INFRA-02 |
| Estimated cost | One-time / recurring | $120,000 annual |
| Required by | Date | 2026-02-15 |

Expense policy (travel & misc):
- Reimbursable items: airfare (economy/business per exec policy), lodging, ground transportation, meals (up to $75/day in NA).
- Non-reimbursable: minibar, spouse expenses, upgrades without approval.
- Expense submission: within 30 days of travel via expense tool with receipts.

5) Vendor Management

Onboarding checklist:
1. Business approval and budget allocation.
2. Vendor risk assessment (template: /confluence/templates/vendor-risk-assessment).
3. Security questionnaire and penetration test results for high-risk vendors.
4. Contract and SLA negotiation with Legal.
5. Provisioning of least-privilege access and audit logging.
6. Quarterly vendor review for critical vendors.

Contract requirements (minimum):
- Data protection addendum (DPA) for any vendor handling PII.
- Right to audit for High and Critical vendors.
- Defined SLAs, incident notification timelines, and termination assistance (data return/wipe).

Vendor risk levels & cadence:
- Low: annual review.
- Medium: semi-annual review (security & performance).
- High/Critical: quarterly review and executive oversight.

6) Travel policy (employee travel & safety)

Booking & approvals:
- All travel booked through the corporate travel portal for expense tracking.
- International travel requires manager approval and People Ops notification 10 business days prior.

Allowances & limits:
- Airfare: economy for domestic; international economy for <8h flights; premium economy or business with exec approval for >8h.
- Lodging: reasonable single-occupancy hotel; preferred hotels negotiated in vendor catalog.
- Meals: per diem up to $75/day in North America, local adjustments apply.

Safety & insurance:
- Company travel insurance covers business travel; travelers must enroll and carry emergency contacts.
- Check travel advisories and obtain approvals for high-risk regions.

Post-travel obligations:
- Submit expense report within 30 days with receipts.
- Complete travel safety checklist if travel was to high-risk area.

7) Internal templates & forms (quick links)

- Access Request: /confluence/templates/access-request
- Change Request: /confluence/templates/change-request
- Data Access Request: /confluence/templates/data-access-request
- Vendor Risk Assessment: /confluence/templates/vendor-risk-assessment
- Procurement Request: /confluence/templates/procurement-request

Appendices

A. Escalation contacts
- People Ops: people-ops@redwood.ai (owner: Aisha Chen)
- Security: security@redwood.ai (oncall rotation listed in /confluence/security-and-compliance/runbooks)
- Finance: procurement@redwood.ai

B. Audit & record retention summary
- Access audits: 3 years.
- Contract records: 7 years (Finance + Legal).
- Security logs: 1 year online, archived for 3 years.

C. Change and access templates (examples)
- Change Request minimum fields: title, owner, change type, risk, rollback plan, test plan, scheduled window, verification steps, monitoring playbook, stakeholders, CAB decision.
- Access Request minimum fields: requestor, approver, justification, duration, resources requested, data sensitivity classification.

Frequently asked questions (FAQ)

Q: Who approves purchases for a new cloud tier?
A: Manager + Finance; >$50k requires Legal + exec sponsor.

Q: What if I need production data for debugging?
A: Submit a Data Access Request; must include justification and masking plan; Security will review and DLP-scan exports.
